<!-- Email sign-up. Provider: Buttondown (buttondown.com).
     The account username appears once, in the form action below.
     If the account name changes, edit it here only. -->
```{=html}
<div class="newsletter" role="region" aria-labelledby="newsletter-heading">
<p id="newsletter-heading" class="newsletter-heading">New posts by email</p>
<p class="newsletter-deck">One email when something new is published on land, agriculture, food systems and climate policy. No other mail. Unsubscribe at any time.</p>
<form class="newsletter-form" action="https://buttondown.com/api/emails/embed-subscribe/ekoperspectives" method="post" target="_blank">
<label class="visually-hidden" for="newsletter-email">Email address</label>
<input id="newsletter-email" type="email" name="email" placeholder="you@example.com" autocomplete="email" required>
<input type="hidden" name="embed" value="1">
<button type="submit">Subscribe</button>
</form>
<p class="newsletter-note">Sent through Buttondown. See the <a href="/privacy.html#email-updates">privacy notice</a>.</p>
</div>
```
